design.site_summary: A partially shaded balcony microclimate designed for a curious cat owner, utilizing safe and engaging planting layers.
design.layout_strategy: Trailing plants cascade from hanging baskets at the vertical level, while aromatic perennials occupy mid-level containers against the wall, and a low grazing zone sits safely at the floor level.
design.combination_logic: The combination contrasts the fine, silvery-green foliage and aromatic clusters of catnip at the floor level with upright structural plants above, providing seasonal interest and sensory enrichment for the cat.

zones.placement: on the east-facing railing, receiving 3 hours of morning sun and sheltered from afternoon heat

plants.why: Provides a safe trailing element when placed in an elevated container.
plants.role_in_combination: Adds soft texture and height variation at the upper boundary.

maintenance: Water thoroughly when the top two inches of soil are dry.
Prune back long stems after flowering to encourage dense growth.

zones.placement: on the shaded balcony floor, directly accessible and reachable by the pet

plants.why: Engages the cat with sensory stimulation and safe grazing.
plants.role_in_combination: Serves as the primary ground-level interactive feature for the pet.

maintenance: Trim occasionally to maintain fresh leaf growth.

care_instructions.task: Water all containers until runoff occurs
care_instructions.frequency: twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn

care_cautions: Overwatering in the hanging baskets can lead to root rot if drainage is blocked.
Excessive consumption of Nepeta cataria by the cat may cause mild digestive upset such as vomiting or diarrhea.
design.pet_safety_note: All selected plants in the accessible grazing zone are non-toxic and specifically chosen for safe feline interaction.
